paragraphs.text: The Norte fire in south Orange County broke out amid strong Santa Ana winds on Friday morning, triggering mandatory evacuations in San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano.
The fire has burned roughly 250 acres as of 2 p.m., according to the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection. It has also burned multiple homes.
Mandatory evacuations were ordered for San Juan Zones 4, 5, and 10 and San Clemente Zone 12. “If you are in one of these zones, leave immediately,” the Orange County Fire Authority wrote on X.

The evacuation zones include a swath of hillside neighborhoods bordered by the 5 Freeway, Ortega Highway and Avenida La Pata. It also extends down into neighborhoods closer to the coast and bordered by the 5 Freeway and Camino Los Mares.
You can find a map of the evacuation zones on the Orange County Sheriff’s Department website.
